Timeline and description of information to have ready. Who to contact to schedule kickoff. Email link to "training.boardeffect.com"[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="BOARD CHAIR RESPONSIBILITIES" tab_id="1460467668437-13f1bd2e-dc57"][vc_column_text]Technical Requirements This document contains information to help you optimize your equipment and network for use with BoardEffect. Network Preparations We recommend that clients ensure that all local hardware and software be set up to ignore traffic going to and from the BoardEffect servers. Exception rules should be enabled for any web content filtering, network caching, or anti-virus scanning. Clients should whitelist the domain boardeffect.com. Please let us know if you need IP addresses for our servers. Email Communications From time to time we communicate important information about BoardEffect to our clients. Additionally, BoardEffect sends notifications through the system alerting users about the status of certain items. Please ensure that your organization can receive system notifications by allowing email from boardeffect.com. Site Images Clients can manage their organization's BoardEffect site images and logos. Below are recommended specifications for the image placeholders: Site Logo – We recommend a horizontal image, no larger than 350px wide x 80px high Print Image – We recommend square and horizontally-oriented logos. BoardEffect will auto re-size uploads to 350px x 350px Welcome Image - 800px wide, x 500px high Photo Profile Image -Pixel perfect square images will auto crop to a circle upon upload to BoardEffect. BoardEffect recommends profile images that are no larger than 200px x 200px. Images that are not a perfect square will auto crop and show as a rectangle in the BoardEffect Directory. Please note that the PNG, GIF & JPG formats are supported. Images with transparent or white backgrounds are recommended. All images should be optimized for the web. Document File Types Meeting Books will accept the following file types: doc, xls, pdf, ppt, docx, xlsx, pptx Resource Library and ‘Other Files’ in Workroom libraries will accept the following file types xlsm, png, gif, docm, jpg, jpeg, doc, xls, mpp, pdf, ppt, tiff, bmp, docx, xlsx, pptx, ps, odt, ods, odp, odg, wmv, avi, mp3, mp4, pps, bmp, csv, tif, msg PDF Documents and Scanning All scanned documents should be OCR scanned and flattened; make sure all your scanning equipment is set to create scans that are searchable and not images. PDF documents should also be created using “Print > PDF” rather than “Save As >PDF.” Meeting Room Preparations Wired Internet connections will provide the fastest Internet response time for anybody accessing BoardEffect from a computer. If you are using wireless Internet in the meeting room and make sure you have an access point or router that can deliver the bandwidth necessary for multiple concurrent connections to the Internet during a meeting, keeping in mind that many users will be utilizing the Internet at any one time to access data through BoardEffect. Recommended Software For administrators: PDF creator/viewer and photo editing software to edit photos and logo images For end users: PDF viewer Supported Browsers BoardEffect is an Internet based service developed with Web 2.0 technology. To maintain security and the best user experience, you must keep your browser up-to-date. BoardEffect supports only browser versions that are supported by the vendor. BoardEffect web applications are designed to work with the most up to date versions of:
  • Chrome
  • Firefox
  • Safari (Mac/Apple only)
  • Microsoft Edge (Windows only)
  • Internet Explorer 11* (Windows only)
*Security Settings for Internet Explorer 11 browsers:
  • Check the box next to Do not save encrypted pages to disk
  • Uncheck the box next to Block unsecured images with other mixed content
These settings ensure that confidential information is not stored and allows the display of embedded images if not secure on a secure page. Recommended Computer Specs Windows
  • Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10 or later
  • An Intel Pentium 4 processor or later that's SSE2 capable
Mac
  • OS X Mavericks 10.9 or later
Mobile  Devices BoardEffect supports device models and operating systems that are supported by the manufacturer.
  • Apple iPad
  • Android tablets
  • iPhone and Android phone (companion app with a reduced feature set)
Choosing the Right Device for your organization There are many factors to consider when selecting a mobile device platform for your organization. We’ve included below some of the key elements to keep in mind, please read the following before deciding which device your organization will recommend and support. Our Client Advocates will be happy to review these considerations with you. If you decide to purchase devices for the board members, or if you plan to recommend a standard for your members, please first test how that device performs by using that device to access BoardEffect files, download meeting books, etc. It’s best to perform the tests from a variety of locations (in the board room, from other corporate network locations, from a home network, etc.).
  • Performance:
      • iPad: The BoardEffect application will work with current supported devices.  We do not recommend using devices that are no longer supported by Apple.
      • Android: Performance and behavior can vary because of the wide variety of devices and Android-device manufacturers. It’s best to choose a business class device from an established brand. Before purchasing multiple devices, first purchase one device and test this with BoardEffect meeting books and any other BoardEffect features you plan to use to confirm that they meet your needs.
    • Functionality:
      • Both Android and iPad apps support downloading meeting books and viewing/annotating them within the BoardEffect application.
  • Reviewing Files in the Resource and Workroom Libraries:
      • iPad: iPad devices use Apple’s default “native file viewer” to display files in the Resource and Workroom Libraries. On the iPad, these files are not downloaded.
      • Android: Android devices don’t include a “native file viewer,” so to open and view Resource and Workroom Library files, users have the option to use a 3rd party app (found in the Google Play store) of their choosing. These 3rd party Apps will download the file to the device.If you do not wish Android users to download and store Resource and Workroom Files on Android devices, you can deactivate this capability for all Android devices in the Mobile Settings area.
Please Note: If you deactivate download of documents to Android devices, users will not have access to content in the Libraries areas (Resource and Workroom Libraries) on Android mobile devices.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="CORPORATE SECRETARY / BOARD LIASON RESPONSIBILITIES" tab_id="1460467723774-83e6abd9-ec84"][vc_column_text]Remove[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="40" css=".vc_custom_1460468482029{margin-bottom: 20px !important;padding-top: 50px !important;}" local_scroll_id="effective"][vc_column][vc_tta_accordion style="modern" color="blue" spacing="10" c_icon="triangle" active_section="" title="RUNNING AN EFFECTIVE BOARD MEETING" collapsible_all="true"][vc_tta_section title="BOARD MEETING AGENDA" tab_id="1460467959414-c5de577f-32ec"][vc_column_text]Timeline reminder, with "you are here." Links to Getting Started Videos Brief review of the purpose of these videos, audience for each (system admin or workroom Admin) Guidlines for using these[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="COMMON BOARD MEETING MISTAKES" tab_id="1460467960039-7f732f80-b41e"][vc_column_text]Recap on what you've learned with the Getting Started videos[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="HOW CAN TECHNOLOGY HELP?" tab_id="1460468123067-0752db12-883e"][vc_column_text]Scheduling your Advanced training Schedule for Advanced training Who to contact (link to training@boardeffect.com email)[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="HELPFUL TIPS" tab_id="1468010145017-029fe185-9807"][vc_column_text]If you have questions...[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][vc_column][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="40" css=".vc_custom_1460468490742{padding-top: 50px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;background-color: #dfe0e8 !important;}" local_scroll_id="procedures"][vc_column][vc_tta_accordion style="modern" shape="square" color="blue" gap="10" c_icon="triangle" active_section="" title="BOARD MEETING PROCEDURES" collapsible_all="true"][vc_tta_section title="NOTICE OF BOARD MEETING" tab_id="1460467023466-1fcd1b15-9aee"][vc_column_text]Some of the minor duties of the board are so routine that they seem insignificant and perhaps, borderline annoying. The risk in not providing a timely notice of a board meeting is that if all of the directors cannot attend, those who were unable to attend may try to overturn the decisions that were made at the meeting. They may even have the right to demand a second meeting and no one will be happy with that. The bylaws rule on whether the meeting notice has to be in writing or whether the notice can be sent by electronic or other means. Look to best practices to set a “reasonable” timeframe. This means giving enough time for directors to decide whether or not to attend the meeting and time to prepare documents for the meeting and agenda. Additional Resources: Notice of the Board Meeting: Regular and Special What are the Responsibilities of the Board Secretary or Board Liaison? What is Board Meeting Protocol? Planning a Board Meeting: A How-to Guide[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="QUORUM" tab_id="1460467024014-32c280ea-db74"][vc_column_text]The purpose of a quorum is two-fold—to make sure that board decisions are made by majority vote and to prevent a tie-vote of the board members. A common requirement for a board quorum is for 2/3 of board members to be present to conduct official business, though the bylaws may state any number. One of the first duties of the board chair is to determine if a quorum is present. Robert’s Rules of Order Newly Revised offers a suggestion on how to set the rules for a quorum. It states that the quorum “should approximate the largest number that can be depended on to attend any meeting except in very bad weather or other extremely unfavorable conditions." Additional Resources: What Constitutes a Quorum How to Chair a Board Meeting What is Board Meeting Protocol?[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="DEALING WITH MOTIONS" tab_id="1460467199502-c6cec964-8087"][vc_column_text]The board chair is primarily responsible for dealing with motions. To keep things democratic, board members have an equal responsibility for knowing how motions should be managed and for speaking up when protocol isn’t being followed. All board members need to understand the purpose, function, and protocol for various kinds of motions including main motions, subsidiary motions, privileged motions, and incidental motions. Clear motions equal clear actions! Additional Resources: How to Write a Motion for a Board Meeting What is Board Meeting Protocol? Managing Motions in Parliamentary Procedure How to Use Incidental Motions Subsidiary Motions: A List of the 7 Types Privileged Motions: A Few Types and Examples[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="VOTING PROCEDURES" tab_id="1460467255276-6b39a813-6ae3"][vc_column_text]The board chair has the responsibility to clearly state a motion before the board. The chair asks for “yea” or “yes” votes and then “nay” or “no” votes. Board members usually give a voice vote, but votes can also be signified with a show of hands, standing to rise, or by ballot. Some bylaws require a vote by roll call. The board chair may elect to retake a vote when the results aren’t clear. Additional Resources: Research Report: U.S. Laws Governing Nonprofit Boards and Electronic Voting How to Write a Motion for a Board Meeting[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" typography_style="white" css=".vc_custom_1444227168062{padding-top: 75px !important;padding-bottom: 75px !important;background-color: #822054 !important;}"][vc_column css_animation="appear"][vcex_icon icon="fa fa-comments" float="center" color="#e497bf" custom_size="40px"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1444228261921{margin-top: 35px !important;}"]

[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="gallagher"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="Healthcare governance is complex. The right tools can make it less complicated. " font_container="tag:h1|font_size:30|text_align:center|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1532448228105{margin-top: 35px !important;margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text]

The boardrooms of hospitals and healthcare organizations are always whirring with activity. With so many decisions to make in a short time frame, healthcare boards need convenient access to the highest quality meeting materials, bylaws, policies, assessments and resources to meet complex strategic challenges. But creating these resources from scratch can be time-consuming, and the quality depends on the availability of in-house talent. Gallagher GovernWell™, in partnership with BoardEffect, offers your healthcare organization a robust set of resources to help your board reach best practice — quickly and efficiently.

item.title: Cookie Policy
item.dc:creator: sherrieg
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row center_row="yes"][vc_column][vc_column_text]BoardEffect Cookies Policy Our websites and our associated online software-as-a-service offerings (the "Online Services") use cookies and other device identifying technologies ("Cookies") to provide our Online Services, to understand how our Online Services are used and for advertising purposes as explained in our Privacy Policy www.diligent.com/privacy.  You can read more about the types of cookies we use, why we use them and how you can exercise your cookies choices below. What are cookies? We and our partners use cookies and similar technologies on our Online Services to improve performance and make your experience better. A cookie is simply a piece of text, which can be placed on the browser of your personal computer or mobile device and subsequently read as you visit a website. A cookie may be a session cookie, that is, a cookie that remains on your browser while you are logged on to a particular web site and then disappears when you close your browser, or it may be a persistent cookie, a cookie that remains on your browser over a period of time. Information from a cookie may be collected and used in aggregate form. We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance the online experience of our visitors and to better understand how the Online Services are used.  These technologies are used in analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users’ movements around the site and to gather demographic information about our user base as a whole. We may receive reports based on the use of these technologies by these companies on an individual as well as aggregated basis.  Cookies may tell us whether you have visited the Online Services before or whether you are a new visitor. We also use cookies to maintain authentication information and to maintain persistent connections across our distributed infrastructure. If you reject cookies, you may have limited features or functionality on our Online Services. There are different types of cookies, for example:
  • Cookies served directly by Diligent ('first party cookies') and cookies served on our behalf, for example by advertisers and data analytics companies ('third party cookies')
  • Cookies which endure for different periods of time, including those that only last only as long as your browser is open (referred to as 'session cookies' or 'temporary cookies'). These are deleted automatically once you close your browser. Other cookies are 'permanent cookies', meaning that they survive after your browser is closed. For example, they recognize your device when you open your browser and browse the internet again.
Which cookies do we use and why do we use them? The following table sets out the different categories of cookies that the Online Services use and why we use them.  
Type of cookie Source What these cookies do How to exercise your cookie choices
Essential website cookies Diligent These cookies are necessary to provide you some of the features of the Online Services, such as access to the browser interfaces of the Online Services. You can control and delete these cookies through your browser settings. If you choose to do so, you will not be able to use the full functionality of the Online Services.
Performance and functionality cookies Google Tag Manager This cookie allows us to manage the cookies we deliver on our website. You can control and delete these cookies through your browser settings. If you choose to do so, you will not be able to use the full functionality of the Online Services.
Analytics cookies Google Analytics, Crazy Egg, Optimizely, New Relic, Triblio, LinkedIn Analytics, Twitter Analytics, and GA Audiences We use Analytics cookie to collect information on how the Online Services is used and to report on the Online Services usage statistics. More information, including details on how to opt-out, is available here. https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout https://www.crazyegg.com/opt-out https://www.optimizely.com/legal/opt-out/ https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/cookie-policy https://triblio.com/privacy-policy/ https://www.linkedin.com/legal/cookie-policy https://help.twitter.com/en/safety-and-security/privacy-controls-for-tailored-ads
Advertising cookies Double Click, Add This, Bing Ads, Marketo, Google AdWords Conversion, LinkedIn Ads, Twitter Advertising, Bizable, Facebook Custom Audiences, Google Dynamic Remarketing, Facebook Pixel, Twitter Conversion Tracking, Google AdWords User Lists] We work with third party advertising networks that collect information using cookies to help make the advertising you see on our online services and elsewhere on the internet more relevant to you, and to measure the effectiveness of the advertising of our online services.  We do not decide which cookies are set or how your data is used by these third parties and therefore you should refer to their privacy policy for further information about which cookies are set and their privacy and information usage practices. You can find information about advertising cookies, including how to see what cookies have been set on your device and how to manage and delete them here (for users in the EU) and here (for users in the U.S.).
Social networking cookies Facebook Connect, Gravatar We work with third party social networks to allow you to easily share content from our website to social networks. You can control and delete these cookies through your browser settings. If you choose to do so, you will not be able to use the full social networking functionality of the website.
Analytics / log files As is true of most websites, we gather certain information automatically and store it in log files.  This information may include Internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, internet service provider (ISP), referring/exit pages, operating system, date/time stamp, and/or clickstream data. We may combine this automatically collected log information with other information we collect about you. We do this to improve services we offer you, or to improve marketing, analytics, or site functionality. We use mobile analytics software to allow us to better understand the performance of the website. This software may record information such as how often you use the website, the events that occur within the website, aggregated usage, and performance data. We do not link the information we store within the analytics software to any information you submit through the website. Behavioral targeting We partner with third parties to either display advertising on our website or to manage our advertising on other sites. Our third-party partner may use technologies such as cookies to gather information about your activities on this site and other sites in order to provide you advertising based upon your browsing activities and interests.  If you wish to not have this information used for the purpose of serving you interest-based ads, you may opt-out by clicking here (or if located in the European Union click here). Please note this does not opt you out of being served ads.  You will continue to receive generic ads. How can you exercise your cookies choices? You have the right to choose whether or not to accept cookies. However, they are an important part of how our Online Services work, so you should be aware that if you choose to refuse or remove cookies, this could affect the availability and functionality the Online Services. If you don’t want the Online Services to use cookies, please follow the instructions in the table above and below. Website (Browser) Opt-Out:  Most browsers accept cookies by default.  You may be able to change the settings to have your browser refuse certain cookies or notify you before accepting cookies.  To do so, please follow the instructions provided by your browser, which are usually located within the "Help", "Tools" or "Edit" menus.  Some third parties also provide the ability to refuse their cookies directly by clicking on an opt-out link, and we have tried to indicate where this is possible in the table above. Mobile App Opt-Out To limit interest-based advertising on your mobile device, you can review and adjust the settings provided by your device manufacturer, such as “Limit Ad Tracking” for iOS or “Opt-out of interest-based ads” for Android. For further information about cookies, including how to see what cookies have been set on your device and how to manage and delete them, please visit www.allaboutcookies.org and www.youronlinechoices.eu. Contact us If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at: privacy@diligent.com.   05/25/2018[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Most nonprofit board members and executive directors agree that having an executive succession plan is essential – identifying the steps to take when the executive director makes a departure, whether planned or unplanned. Yet research shows 60% of nonprofits don’t have a succession plan in place, citing a lack of support for developing sustainability and difficulty building a leadership bench. Creating a succession plan doesn’t have to be so difficult. The five tips for executive succession planning, will include: 
  1. Organizing the people & process
  2. Dealing with the “elephant in the room” 
  3. Tools to keep everything on track 
  4. Options for communicating the plan 
  5. Strategies to keep the plan fresh over time 
We’ll provide five tips, and open the floor for your thoughts, questions, and ideas. You’ll leave with some practical strategies you can use immediately.

WHY YOUR SMB NEEDS A BOARD PORTAL

BoardEffect drives efficiency, effectiveness and engagement among board directors, executives and administrators for small and medium sized businesses to ensure compliance and improved governance for the growth and success of their organization. With the right tools to access and collaborate with the information they need, when they need it, BoardEffect's intuitive and affordable board management solution will help SMBs drive success through always-on technology that is available no matter where you are.

More than 2,000 leading organizations and over 155,000 users rely on BoardEffect to manage board-related information online and advance the work of their boards.  Board Effect's board portal technology is utilized by some of the world's leading organizations and has been used very successfully by SMBs to make sure investors and boards can steer the company in the right direction. The growth of your business is very important to BoardEffect and by using the right technology to make sure there is a clear channel of communication and boardroom processes from the beginning can help accelerate your company's mission. By leveraging BoardEffect to support the dynamic, nuanced, critically important work of governing bodies, you can quickly see why BoardEffect is the most popular board management system for businesses.

With the BoardEffect platform, your organization can attain easy management of board information, while also enabling board directors to fulfill their responsibilities of elevating organizational performance.

Also, with our integration with Salesforce, you will easily be able to provide your board with the right information, with single-sign on and the ability to bridge sales reports with meeting tools. Additionally, your board will be able to save drastically on costs by adopting a tool that is built specifically for driving organizational success from those people responsible for running your company. Because board governance is so complex, demanding, and creates high-stakes for any company, making sure you get it right from the start is essential for the long-term success of your business. With BoardEffect’s board portal software, your company will be supported by putting forth the best practices within and across each cycle of board and investor activity.

An effective board meeting begins with a board that has a healthy board culture and board members who bring the right characteristics to the table. A board of directors that has a strong understanding of the principles of good corporate governance will be able to fulfill board duties responsibly and collaboratively. However, in order to run a truly effective and productive board meeting, board members must factor in a number of important components, including:

  • Discussing long- and short-term goals
  • Developing good working relationships with managers
  • Understanding the role of the agenda
  • Managing conflicts of interest
…and more considerations that contribute to positive board meeting outcomes.

BoardMax, the web-based board portal known for driving board member engagement and good governance, is now a part of the global BoardEffect family.  The board management tool, which is more robust than the BoardMax software you have come to trust, includes more features and state-of-the-art security that your organization’s board will use to more effectively meet their governance needs. Created for administrative assistants, executives and board members alike, BoardEffect is the ideal board portal solution for any organization looking to support the dynamic, nuanced and critically important work of their governing bodies. BoardEffect drives efficiency, effectiveness and engagement among board directors, executives and administrators. More than 2,000 leading organizations and over 155,000 users rely on BoardEffect to manage board-related information online and advance the work of their boards. Hospitals and healthcare systems, nonprofits, foundations, educational institutions, government entities, companies and many others leverage BoardEffect to support good governance.

Offering even more features than BoardMax like minute meeting tools, BoardEffect allows truly easy management of board information, while also enabling board directors to fulfill their responsibilities of elevating organizational performance at a reasonable price. Just like with BoardMax pricing, we’re committed to saving you money with our pricing model. Our pricing is custom depending on your organization’s needs. For more information on BoardEffect cost, please request pricing information.

Healthcare governance is complex. BoardEffect empowers community healthcare organizations to streamline secure communication and effectively manage board meeting processes while saving time and resources. It’s a HIPAA-compliant, secure board management solution for community healthcare works, empowering strategic planning, reporting, document sharing and other agenda and meeting management tasks so you can continue to focus on your mission.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" center_row="yes"][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Enable Modern Governance for Healthcare Organizations with BoardEffect" font_container="tag:h3|font_size:16|text_align:left|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1631306631518{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1632165928082{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"]
  • Trusted and user-friendly technology to streamline board management processes and free up time to focus on people you care for
  • Real-time mobile access to critical, confidential board materials for healthcare executives and trustees on the go with access to 24/7 support at your fingertips
  • Data security and HIPAA compliance ensures medical information and other sensitive data is protected
  • Integration with video conferencing and single sign-on solutions balances security with ease of use
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_video link="https://vimeo.com/295378076"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1546968923608{margin-top: 15px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="Data Security and Built-In HIPAA Compliance Maintenance" font_container="tag:h2|font_size:30|text_align:center|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1631306668293{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text]

We go beyond the required controls for HIPAA compliance, such as implementing data encryption, so healthcare organizations can better align the platform with their unique technical, legal, and regulatory requirements. You can even sign Business Associate Agreements required by HIPAA – something only BoardEffect allows you to do.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1598992444388{padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2"][vcex_button url="/live-demo/" size="medium" title="JOIN A LIVE DEMO" style="flat" align="right" color="orange" custom_background="#fc4a04" custom_hover_background="#fc4a04" custom_color="#ffffff" custom_hover_color="#ffffff"]JOIN A LIVE DEMO[/vcex_button][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vcex_button url="/PRICING/" size="medium" title="REQUEST PRICING" style="flat" align="left"]REQUEST PRICING[/vcex_button][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1598992961047{margin-bottom: 5px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="Customer Success Stories" font_container="tag:h2|font_size:30|text_align:left|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1631308176412{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1631308093824{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"]

[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="BoardEffect Streamlines Governance for Salinas Valley Memorial Healthcare System" font_container="tag:h3|font_size:16|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1631308222642{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"]
“We used to spend much more time preparing board materials,” explains Karen. “Now the process is much quicker. And it’s certainly easier to hit the print button than to stand for hours at a copy machine in order to create hard copies of the board book”

item.title: Governance for Lunch: Governing at the Speed of a Tweet
item.dc:creator: mlopez
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row column_spacing="60" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1546968923608{margin-top: 15px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="Governing at the Speed of a Tweet: How Can Nonprofit Boards Keep Up?" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:30|text_align:center|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1560796249188{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1560798011195{padding-bottom: 15px !important;}"]There has never been a time when serving on a nonprofit board has been more challenging than right now.  Board oversight comes with more risk now than ever before – from operating in an political climate where a single presidential Tweet can upend current policy, to the potential risk of having a #MeToo incident among your nonprofit’s top leadership, to the possibility of a cyber breach impacting the most vulnerable users of your services.  In this complex landscape, the question becomes – how can nonprofit boards keep up? Join Dottie Schindlinger, VP of Thought Leadership of Diligent (the parent company of BoardEffect) and co-author of the recently released book, Governance in the Digital Age, for a fast-paced exploration of ways nonprofit boards can keep up with the times.  We’ll explore some of the themes and lessons learned from the book, including:
  • In this age of digital disruption and Twitter-speed news, what actually helps directors govern better?
  • For organizations with the best performance results, what is different about the way their boards function?
  • To what extent are the norms and practices of governance beginning to transform to meet new challenges?
  • Perhaps most importantly, what approaches, tools and technology might help directors and boards transform governance for the digital age?

However, actually putting the numerous techniques and approaches into practice is less common. In considering the best practices for nonprofit boards, we should do so in the context of modern governance, which is the practice of empowering leaders with the technology, insights and processes required to fuel good governance in today’s digital environment. In this whitepaper, we examine the top five nonprofit governance practices that position organizations for long-term growth and success, including:
  • Aligning strategies, goals and capacity
  • Building the board effectively
  • Defining how the board will work
  • Providing appropriate oversight
  • Promoting accountability and engagement

item.title: BoardEffect's Response to COVID-19
item.dc:creator: lena
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="BoardEffect's Response to COVID-19" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:center" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1584112439008{margin-top: 35px !important;margin-right: 35px !important;margin-left: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1584365727811{margin-top: 40px !important;margin-right: 250px !important;margin-left: 250px !important;}"]As a steward of modern governance and part of the Diligent family, the BoardEffect team is taking comprehensive measures to ensure our employees, products, and services continue to operate at the highest levels of performance and support as the COVID-19 epidemic continues to evolve. Governance is critical in times of uncertainty, and we want to make sure our customers and partners know that they can confidently rely on BoardEffect during this time. To provide greater visibility and assurance, we are highlighting a few ways BoardEffect is upholding its devotion to supporting our customers, partners and employees.

Secure Infrastructure & Communications

Over 180,000 leaders worldwide rely on the BoardEffect platform to facilitate board and committee meetings, conduct surveys and voting, securely share sensitive information, and drive modern governance best practices in their organizations. Recognizing that threats to operations and business continuity are ever present, BoardEffect emphasizes security and reliability as guiding principles for its people and for the information entrusted to its systems. We are committed to maintaining all product service levels for availability, access, and security, globally, despite any virus-related challenges that we face. This includes continual improvement and releases of new product capabilities to support our customers’ modern governance needs.

Protecting Our Workforce

The health and safety of our employees are of the utmost importance to BoardEffect and Diligent. As the situation evolves, the BoardEffect and Diligent leadership team is ensuring that every employee has the tools and technology to work remotely to maintain business continuity. As companies that work to improve the remote work of business and organizational leaders, BoardEffect and Diligent use best-in-class tools for collaboration, audio and video communication, messaging, and secure identity, along with other business-critical technologies. Furthermore, BoardEffect and Diligent have restricted all non-essential travel, including all conferences, until risks have subsided. Executive leadership has emphasized the importance of following CDC and WHO recommendations to ensure safety. BoardEffect and Diligent have also adjusted its internal work structure to limit potential risks in the workplace.

Support Resources

We know that governance software and the resources available to customers are mission critical. Therefore, we want to assure customers that our Customer Success and Support Teams will continue to operate as normal and are available to assist customers with any and all account management requests. We highly value your partnership with BoardEffect. We are always here to support business continuity and wellbeing, and especially during uncertainty. Brian Stafford President & CEO Diligent Corporation[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

With the sudden shift to remote work, it has become clear that organizations need to embrace a digital transformation sooner than expected. Mission-driven organizations have found themselves in need of additional support to adapt to the new normal – including virtual city council meetings, increased transparency and communication from school boards and districts, and online non-profit board meetings. Increasing transparency is a hallmark of board portals. Organizations, hard hit by pandemic related expenses, still seek to communicate effectively with stakeholders while keeping community members and employees safe and informed. This grant award of $1000, used to offset the implementation costs of a Diligent contract, is available to any government, education or registered non-profit organization if they apply by December 15, 2020.

[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="hiring-and-onboarding-a-nonprofit-ceo-in-a-digital-world"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" equal_height="yes" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1555013099583{margin-top: 100px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" min_height="750px"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_custom_heading text="Hiring and Onboarding a Nonprofit CEO in a Digital World" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:32|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1635963184256{margin-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_column_text]In the best of times, finding and hiring a new chief executive for your nonprofit is a complex process. Even when everything is running smoothly and the board has the necessary time and expertise to carry out the search, the process itself typically requires 7-10 months of ongoing work. With the rate of nonprofit executive turnover averaging 18-22% each year, most nonprofit boards are likely to face this challenge at some point in their tenure. As the demand for nonprofit executive search is growing, over the past year, it had to be conducted virtually to comply with pandemic public health and safety measures. Many organizations are still operating remotely – and might continue to do so even beyond the end of the pandemic. Given all these realities, how can nonprofits successfully hire and onboard a new chief executive virtually? item.dc:creator: mlopez
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="healthcare-page-2"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60" css=".vc_custom_1546968923608{margin-top: 15px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="Healthcare governance is complex. The right tools can make it less complicated." font_container="tag:h1|font_size:30|text_align:center|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1546968863025{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text]

BoardEffect, a Diligent company, was designed for the work of efficient and collaborative boards to enable effective leaders. Healthcare executives and trustees have long relied on BoardEffect to improve board management and streamline secure communications. Healthcare experiences twice the number of cyber attacks as other industries; in 2017 alone, the number of incidents increased by 210%, and 5.6 million patient records were affected. The stakes are high for protecting your board’s sensitive information. BoardEffect’s client base is comprised of healthcare organizations ranging from small local hospitals with basic board structures, to national hospital systems and networks with complex needs. By putting compliance, reporting, strategic planning, meeting management and more in one secure place, BoardEffect streamlines governance. Backed by over a decade of experience, our board portal solution empowers healthcare organizations to better manage board operations while providing cost-effective scales to accommodate the mergers, acquisitions and evolving requirements of the future.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60" css=".vc_custom_1549910641270{padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2"][vcex_button url="/request-a-demo/" title="REQUEST A DEMO" style="flat" align="right" size="medium" color="orange" custom_background="#fc4a04" custom_hover_background="#fc4a04" custom_color="#ffffff" custom_hover_color="#ffffff"]REQUEST A DEMO[/vcex_button][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vcex_button url="/PRICING/" title="REQUEST PRICING" style="flat" align="left" size="medium"]REQUEST PRICING[/vcex_button][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60"][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="With BoardEffect, your healthcare organization can: " font_container="tag:h3|font_size:16|text_align:left|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1546963088415{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1546963075426{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"]
  • Enhance efficiency for board and staff
  • Provide security and control for important content
  • Ensure board member engagement
  • Document all governance activity
  • Demonstrate a commitment to governance best practice
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_video link="https://vimeo.com/295378076"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60" css=".vc_custom_1546983164381{padding-top: 0px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="With over 2,000 customers and 180,000 users globally, BoardEffect is the governance leader that puts customers first. Among our user base, over 40% come from the healthcare sector. This unique position gives us a valuable understanding of the particular regulations and the security needs of boards in the sector." font_container="tag:h2|font_size:30|text_align:center|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1549911716799{margin-top: 50px !important;margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1546967056184{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"]
BoardEffect is really intuitive – not overwhelming – but what creates additional engagement by the board members is their ability to access
not only board meeting materials in ‘real time’ but also supporting documents that are all located in one easy-to-use tool.”
- Kelli Ockinga, Executive Assistant, Mary Lanning Healthcare
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60" css=".vc_custom_1549910641270{padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2"][vcex_button url="/request-a-demo/" title="REQUEST A DEMO" style="flat" align="right" size="medium" color="orange" custom_background="#fc4a04" custom_hover_background="#fc4a04" custom_color="#ffffff" custom_hover_color="#ffffff"]REQUEST A DEMO[/vcex_button][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vcex_button url="/PRICING/" title="REQUEST PRICING" style="flat" align="left" size="medium"]REQUEST PRICING[/vcex_button][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60" css=".vc_custom_1546968923608{margin-top: 15px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="Data Security and Built-In HIPAA Compliance Maintenance" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:30|text_align:center|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1549911784097{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text]

When Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) are stolen, they remain with a person forever and the theft is much more difficult to resolve. Since many board portals are used to store PHI, it is particularly important for boards to ensure compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

BoardEffect’s board portal software goes beyond the required controls for HIPAA compliance, such as implementing data encryption, allowing healthcare organizations to align the platform with their unique technical, legal and regulatory requirements. BoardEffect even signs Business Associate Agreements required by HIPAA, setting itself apart from other board portal providers.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60" css=".vc_custom_1549912432941{margin-bottom: 15px !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Features that Feel Familiar from Day One " font_container="tag:h3|font_size:16|text_align:left|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1549911943013{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1549911986120{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"]We know that board members and administrators are busy, which is why we made BoardEffect easy to use for: • Curating and sharing the latest data • Staying up to speed before and between meetings • Securely collaborating in committees and workrooms • Administering polls, surveys, voting and more[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1549912152804{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"]The smartphone- and tablet-compatible dashboard works like popular online apps. Additionally, personalized onboarding and weekly webinars help users get up to speed quickly—for maximum usage and ROI. As the only board portal platform built on API infrastructure, BoardEffect integrates with other mission-critical systems, so board activities easily connect with recruitment, strategic planning and more. Our commitment to state-of-the-art security means you can feel confident that medical information and other sensitive data is protected, while essential information is readily available for audits and reporting.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60" css=".vc_custom_1549910641270{padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2"][vcex_button url="/healthcare-board-portal/#minutes" title="REQUEST A DEMO" style="flat" align="right" size="medium" color="orange" custom_background="#fc4a04" custom_hover_background="#fc4a04" custom_color="#ffffff" custom_hover_color="#ffffff"]REQUEST A DEMO[/vcex_button][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vcex_button url="/PRICING/" title="REQUEST PRICING" style="flat" align="left" size="medium"]REQUEST PRICING[/vcex_button][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60" css=".vc_custom_1519167163061{margin-bottom: 75px !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Exclusively for BoardEffect Healthcare Customers: " font_container="tag:h3|font_size:16|text_align:left|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1546968688055{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1549911838603{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"]
  • Streamline governance technology beyond board books:
    • Minutes: Integrated minute taking and action management for BoardEffect. Minutes enables you to take meeting minutes more efficiently and securely, and design action items easily.
    • Messenger: The safer, smarter way to communicate with your board. Messenger is a one-stop-shop for document sharing and secure communications.
  • HIPAA compliance: BoardEffect adheres to rigorous requirements for safeguarding data compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and HITECH. BoardEffect’s HIPAA compliance goes well beyond mere technical controls, it invokes a series of safeguards and policies
  • New healthcare resources: We partnered with Gallagher GovernWell to provide a robust set of healthcare resources with governance best practices.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="11696"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row center_row="yes" column_spacing="60" css=".vc_custom_1546983220550{padding-top: 35px !important;background-color: #dfe0e8 !important;}" el_id="minutes"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="REQUEST A DEMONSTRATION" font_container="tag:h2|font_size:30|text_align:center|color:%231a4e7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1546968898980{margin-top: 50px !important;margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1546961394609{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"]

item.content:encoded:
[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="top-5-best-practices-in-nonprofit-governance"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" equal_height="yes" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1555013099583{margin-top: 100px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" min_height="750px"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_custom_heading text="Elevate your nonprofit board governance with these top five best practices" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:32|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1722592993829{margin-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_column_text]Navigating the complex world of nonprofit board governance can be a daunting task. Although many techniques are recognized as highly effective, they are often underutilized. We have focused simply on five key best practices tailored to today's governance in the nonprofit sector. While board responsibilities remain constant, cultural norms, risks, tools, external influences and board members' lives continually evolve. These best practices empower leaders with the technology, insights, and processes required for effective governance today. In this guide, we draw insights from various sectors, including education, healthcare, social services and the corporate world, to distill best practices that apply universally to nonprofit governance. You will understand:
  • How to align strategies, goals and capacity.
  • Ways to build the board effectively.
  • Defining how the board will work.
  • How to provide appropriate oversight.
  • Ways to promote accountability and engagement.
Download the guide now to empower your nonprofit board with the tools and insights needed for effective governance.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_column_text][marketoembed '10084'  '946-AVX-095'][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row typography_style="white" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1554750845944{padding-top: 50px !important;padding-bottom: 50px !important;background-color: #194f7d !important;}"][vc_column css_animation="fadeInUp" el_class="testimonial"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1554750810375{margin-top: 35px !important;}" font_family="Barlow"]

[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="revised_buyers_guide_wp"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" equal_height="yes" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1555013099583{margin-top: 100px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" min_height="750px"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_custom_heading text="Boardroom Technology: The Board Portal Buyer's Guide" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:32|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1554397931782{margin-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Make the best decision for your board when choosing boardroom technology" font_container="tag:h2|font_size:20px|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1554397939195{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text]Organizations’ needs are rapidly growing as both the digital landscape and scope of governance changes and expands. Delivering the best data and insights to leaders while ensuring advanced cybersecurity and effective governance is something all organizations should strive for. A board portal can deliver these results with ease – but not all of the software on the market is the same. This guide is your go-to source for understanding what to look for in a board portal and how to reap the most benefits. Read on to learn about important board portal evaluation criteria such as:
  • Focus on governance
  • Features & functions

item.title: Robert’s Rules of Order Cheat Sheet
item.dc:creator: jholtz
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="roberts_rule-1"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1604695163984{margin-top: 100px !important;}"][vc_column width="2/3" css=".vc_custom_1604695187321{margin-top: 35px !important;margin-right: 30px !important;margin-left: 100px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Engage in meetings with confidence and clarity!" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1740742461004{margin-bottom: 35px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1740742527324{margin-right: 100px !important;}"]This Robert's Rules of Order cheat sheet is your ultimate guide to ensuring structured, fair and efficient meetings.

Why Robert's Rules of Order?

Discover the power of Robert's Rules of Order, a set of guidelines designed to make your meetings more productive and inclusive. These rules ensure that every voice is heard, debates remain orderly and decisions are made effectively. Whether you're moving to adjourn, amending a motion or calling for a division, our cheat sheet provides the tools you need to navigate any meeting with ease.

What's in the cheatsheet?

The cheat sheet is organized into clear, concise sections, making it easy to find the information you need at a glance. Here’s a sneak peek:
  • Introduce main motion: Learn how to propose new ideas and ensure they are considered fairly.
  • Amend a motion: Understand the process for modifying proposals and how to do it effectively.
  • Adjourn the meeting: Know the proper procedure to end meetings smoothly and efficiently.
Each section includes the specific motion phrase, whether it can be debated, amended or reconsidered and the required vote. We also provide practical wording to help you apply these rules.

How to get the most out of the cheat sheet

  • Make sure the cheat sheet is easily accessible to all your board members.
  • Secure support from top leadership to emphasize its importance.
  • Encourage the adoption of the cheat sheet to enhance meeting efficiency.
  • Offer training sessions to familiarize board members with the content.
Ready to transform your meetings? Their challenges included:
  • Coordinating board meeting logistics, scheduling and time-consuming administrative tasks related to board management
  • Accessing past documents for reference during meetings, as documents were located in several different places
  • Staying on top of document and information access as board members completed their terms or resigned
“We’re going through a massive governance update. It is necessary to maintain three things: best practices, compliance to protect our tax-exempt status and to keep our members informed as to their rights and obligations. BoardEffect is a part of that for us.”
As well as helping to facilitate and prepare for board meetings throughout the year, BoardEffect provides a secure platform to protect proprietary information and to distribute large documents efficiently and securely to numerous stakeholders. The key security features, including robust controls, granular permissions, secure file sharing and protection of sensitive documents, have also impressed LRA.[/vc_column_text][vcex_spacing][vc_column_text]Download the full case study now to read more.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row typography_style="white" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1554750845944{padding-top: 50px !important;padding-bottom: 50px !important;background-color: #194f7d !important;}"][vc_column css_animation="fadeInUp" el_class="testimonial"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1554750810375{margin-top: 35px !important;}" font_family="Barlow"]

Their challenges included:
  • Coordinating board meeting logistics, scheduling and time-consuming administrative tasks related to board management and communications
  • Laboriously managing multiple departments and committees, as well as coordinating and gathering documents for meetings
  • Time-intensive compiling of necessary documentation for re-accreditation every three years
“At first, there was resistance from board members due to different levels of technology skills. But now, neither the directors, staff, nor I can imagine providing and accessing the meeting materials any other way.” – Debbi Beaver, Board Executive Assistant, Memorial Health System
Time spent on administrative tasks has been greatly reduced, allowing more focus on meeting content itself, with easy access to an archive of past meeting documents as required. Memorial Health System has now expanded use of BoardEffect beyond just the board with a significant number of committees and internal groups benefiting from the Workrooms feature.[/vc_column_text][vcex_spacing][vc_column_text]Download the full case study now to see how Memorial Health System tackled these challenges.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row typography_style="white" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1554750845944{padding-top: 50px !important;padding-bottom: 50px !important;background-color: #194f7d !important;}"][vc_column css_animation="fadeInUp" el_class="testimonial"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1554750810375{margin-top: 35px !important;}" font_family="Barlow"]

For a mission-driven organization short on staffing, time and budget, artificial intelligence (AI) can seem like a magic wand. It’s effectively a force multiplier for organizations with big missions and limited resources, improving efficiency and enhancing decision-making. It’s a particularly powerful value proposition for mission-driven organizations. But for community-focused charities and not-for-profit organizations, it's important to wield this magic wand with caution. AI risk encompasses many areas, from data privacy to bias to employee and beneficiary trust. But ultimately one group is responsible for overseeing it: the board. This checklist is designed to help your board ensure that AI usage happens within policies, guidelines, rules and regulations instead of being like the “Wild West.” Download the checklist today and start promoting responsible AI use throughout your organization.

item.dc:creator: jholtz
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="board-meeting-minutes-template-11"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" equal_height="yes" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1555013099583{margin-top: 100px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" min_height="750px"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_custom_heading text="Download our case study" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:32|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1693297614579{margin-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_single_image image="23904"][vcex_spacing][vc_column_text]Starfish Family Services is a social service agency that works to strengthen families and create brighter futures for children, offering many free services to over 3,000 children and their families. With 21 serving board members, they wanted to increase efficiency and digitize the process of creating and sharing agendas and documents for board and committee meetings. Their challenges included:
  • Without a centralized platform for board business, Starfish found it difficult to efficiently prepare for board meetings and coordinate meeting logistics.
  • Board books, sometimes up to 300 pages, had to be compiled by hand, manually printed and collated before inserting them into binders.
  • Board participation was difficult to track and there was no centralized resource library where board members could easily find past documents.
  • Reporting back to federally funded programs which have strict compliance obligations was time-consuming and onerous.
"Having everything in one place is extremely beneficial. I have a lot of requests for items from previous years. Now I click some boxes and here you go, it looks like I'm a magical worker! BoardEffect has saved me hours of searching for different information." - Susan Bovair, Executive Assistant to the CEO and Board Liaison, Starfish Family Services
By leveraging BoardEffect’s efficiency features and using it as a central location to store everything in one place, hours of time have been saved each day. Board meetings are now running efficiently and staying on schedule while the online Document Library provides quick access to essential documents that answer board members’ questions as they prepare for meetings Using BoardEffect has also led to increased board engagement with meeting features and easy access materials assisting in facilitating hybrid meetings, as Susan confirms, “Attendance has been through the roof since we introduced hybrid”.[/vc_column_text][vcex_spacing][vc_column_text]Download the full case study now to find out more to see how Starfish Family Services tackled these challenges.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row typography_style="white" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1554750845944{padding-top: 50px !important;padding-bottom: 50px !important;background-color: #194f7d !important;}"][vc_column css_animation="fadeInUp" el_class="testimonial"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1554750810375{margin-top: 35px !important;}" font_family="Barlow"]

item.title: Case Study – Pennsylvania Chamber of Business and Industry
item.dc:creator: jholtz
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="board-member-onboarding-one-pager-11"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" equal_height="yes" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1555013099583{margin-top: 100px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" min_height="750px"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_custom_heading text="Download our case study" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:32|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1693297614579{margin-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_single_image image="24117"][vcex_spacing][vc_column_text]Headquartered in Harrisburg, the Pennsylvania Chamber of Business and Industry serves 10,000 member businesses of all sizes and industry sectors throughout the state, from sole proprietors to Fortune 100 companies. With a large board and layers of committees and subsidiary boards comprising over 100 members, the chamber needed a way to streamline board communications, management processes and keep everyone engaged and informed. Their challenges were numerous:
  • Without a centralized platform for board business, the chamber found it a challenge to efficiently organize meeting logistics, and to prepare and distribute board packets for meetings.
  • Getting board members to sign documents, such as conflict-of-interest forms, was a process that involved uploading and downloading signable PDFs.
  • In addition, tracking down signatures and ensuring that members had included the correct information and filled them out correctly was time-consuming and labor-intensive.
  • Consistent board communication was also a challenge to keep such a large board (and their assistants) engaged and informed.
The complexities of communicating with and engaging a large board have been simplified with BoardEffect. The platform is now the single source for information, and board members and their assistants don’t have to search through old emails for what they need, saving time.
“It's life-changing. I don't even know how I would still be working here if I didn't have some sort of platform to help ease this whole process.” – Carissa Burgett, board administrator and assistant to president and CEO

item.dc:creator: jholtz
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="digital-signatures-in-boardeffect-thank-you-1"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" equal_height="yes" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1555013099583{margin-top: 100px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" min_height="750px"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_custom_heading text="A guide to diversity, equity and inclusion" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:32|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1710409337468{margin-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_single_image image="24195"][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text]In the U.S. nonprofit sector, boards continue to remain overwhelmingly white and male. In the absence of government-mandated quotas, U.S. nonprofits have voluntarily developed diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) frameworks and practices, recognizing that a DEI strategy is vital to future-proofing an organization. DEI measures are essential for board members to feel valued and respected in the workplace. This guide examines who still doesn’t have a seat at the table on volunteer boards in the United States, despite global change, and why it isn’t enough to tick a box. You'll learn:
  • What DEI is and why it matters
  • DEI strategies for nonprofits
  • 6 steps to implementing a successful DEI strategy today
  • How technology can help your board and organization reach its DEI goals
Download the guide now to get the tools you need to enact meaningful DEI measures.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row typography_style="white" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1554750845944{padding-top: 50px !important;padding-bottom: 50px !important;background-color: #194f7d !important;}"][vc_column css_animation="fadeInUp" el_class="testimonial"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1554750810375{margin-top: 35px !important;}" font_family="Barlow"]

item.dc:creator: jholtz
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="board-meeting-minutes-template-12"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" equal_height="yes" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1555596667939{margin-top: 100px !important;margin-bottom: 20px !important;}" min_height="750px"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_custom_heading text="Keep your board running smoothly as volunteer board members come and go" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:32|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1715861579525{margin-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_single_image image="24513"][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text]Managing the lifecycle of volunteer board members in a nonprofit or mission-driven organization can be a daunting task. A volunteer board is almost always in flux. A new member is learning the ropes. A longtime member has just submitted a notice of resignation. To effectively manage this constant cycle of change — known as the board member lifecycle — mission-driven leaders must build trustee lifecycle management strategies into their daily work. But how can you accomplish this when time and resources are so hard to come by? [vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="louisiana-restaurant-association-case-study-11"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" equal_height="yes" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1555013099583{margin-top: 100px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" min_height="750px"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_custom_heading text="Download our case study" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:32|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1693297614579{margin-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_single_image image="25111"][vcex_spacing][vc_column_text]McCoy College of Business Foundation were looking for a board management solution that would allow their board to access information on a secure platform from anywhere and at any time with secure and searchable document storage capabilities. Their challenges included:
  • Changes at the last minute to board documents and the agenda meant reprinting large board packets
  • Emailing board documents didn't work as documents were too large while storage limits and fees for digital storage of historical documents was causing an issue
  • Board members in different geographical locations found it tricky to access the documents they needed to prepare for meetings.
BoardEffect turned out to be just what the foundation board needed. Using a single platform that all board members and staff could access eliminated the need for paper binders and overnight shipping charges. Now everything is securely stored online, allowing easy access for board members and staff.
“Using this platform has made the governance of our foundation easier, more transparent and more accessible to our members and staff. I highly recommend this product.” - Cindy Fornash, Foundation Administrator
Since implementation, the Foundation has saved hours of time as well as eliminating printing and mailing costs. They use the workroom features to allow guests to participate and committees to collaborate easily while the secure central document repository delivers accessibility.[/vc_column_text][vcex_spacing][vc_column_text]Download the full case study now to find out more.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row typography_style="white" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1554750845944{padding-top: 50px !important;padding-bottom: 50px !important;background-color: #194f7d !important;}"][vc_column css_animation="fadeInUp" el_class="testimonial"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1554750810375{margin-top: 35px !important;}" font_family="Barlow"]

[vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider_vc alias="orthovirginia-case-study"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row column_spacing="60" equal_height="yes" center_row="yes" css=".vc_custom_1555013099583{margin-top: 100px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;}" min_height="750px"][vc_column width="2/3"][vc_custom_heading text="Discover how OrthoVirginia boosted security & efficiency with BoardEffect" font_container="tag:h1|font_size:32|text_align:left|color:%23194f7d" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1724672485870{margin-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_single_image image="25170"][vcex_spacing][vc_column_text]Are you tired of the cumbersome, insecure processes that bog down your board's decision-making? Discover how OrthoVirginia Inc., the largest orthopedic practice in Virginia, transformed their governance with BoardEffect.

The challenge: Insecure voting & time-consuming processes

OrthoVirginia's Board of Directors, overseeing 159 physicians across 36 offices, faced a daunting challenge: maintaining confidentiality and efficiency. Sensitive votes required mailing in signed affidavits, compromising confidentiality and trust. Meanwhile, handling vast amounts of administrative tasks became a chore for their Chief of Staff, Melissa Wilmoth.

Transformative results

Melissa and CEO Dr. David Jevsevar, having had positive experiences with BoardEffect at previous employers, championed its adoption at OrthoVirginia. Since implementing BoardEffect, OrthoVirginia has seen a dramatic improvement in efficiency and confidentiality. Here's how:
  • BoardEffect’s multi-layered security ensures voting privacy and legal compliance.
  • Votes that used to take weeks now take just 24 hours.
  • Regional admins now independently manage documents, polls, and meetings, freeing up central office resources.
  • Enhanced security prevents unauthorized document sharing.
  • One unified platform ensures consistency and security across all locations.
“Previously, collecting votes via e-mail and affidavits was time-consuming and inefficient. Now, we have results within 24 hours thanks to BoardEffect.” - Melissa Wilmoth, Chief of Staff to OrthoVirginia’s Chief Executive Officer

You're not alone. Presbyterian SeniorCare Network, the largest senior living provider in Western Pennsylvania, faced similar challenges. With over 6,500 older adults in their care, inefficiencies in board and committee meetings were hampering their focus on providing excellent care.

Their challenges

Imagine managing board and committee meetings for a nonprofit with numerous affiliates and a near-century-long history. Paper documents and PDFs were causing inconsistencies, and board engagement was suffering. The Presbyterian SeniorCare Network knew they needed a game-changer.

Enter BoardEffect

With quick setup, comprehensive training, and powerful features, Presbyterian SeniorCare Network saw an immediate turnaround. Liz Thompson, executive assistant to the president and board secretary, says: “I set up the platform with advice from our BoardEffect rep. The training was intuitive and accessible, making the launch smooth.”

The results

  • 75% reduction in material prep time: Imagine saving hours, even days, on meeting prep. No more waiting for paper copies or last-minute email attachments.
  • Improved board engagement: With a robust resource library and self-serve onboarding tools, board members are more engaged than ever.
  • Streamlined surveys: Custom surveys for board evaluations lead to faster decision-making and higher participation rates.
  • Enhanced onboarding: New board members get up to speed quickly with self-guided materials available right on the platform.
“The efficiencies that BoardEffect has brought to my life are immeasurable”, Liz Thompson, Executive Assistant to the President & Corporate Secretary and Corporate Compliance Officer

Are you worried about the security and confidentiality of your board communications? You’re not alone. CUES is a membership organization serving over 50,000 credit union leaders. Their mission? Amplifying credit unions through leadership development, top-tier education, and robust networking opportunities. But their journey to streamlined board management wasn’t easy — then they found BoardEffect.

The challenge: Speed and confidentiality concerns

When Ruth Shirley joined CUES as the Executive Administrator, she quickly realized their existing board management system was a mess. It was clunky, time-consuming and anything but user-friendly. Imagine spending two to three weeks just to gather information and prepare agendas. Worse yet, their top priority — security and confidentiality — felt constantly at risk. They needed a better solution, fast.

The solution: Enter BoardEffect's secure and efficient technology

After a seamless demo, the CEO and Board Chair were sold. The transition was smooth and the benefits were immediate:
  • Faster board book preparation: What once took up to three weeks now takes less than one.
  • Effortless agenda management: Shirley loves the agenda management feature as it helps her create the book faster.
  • Secure, accessible documents: Board members can now view, sign and approve documents quickly and securely.

The results: Enhanced efficiency and security

BoardEffect has revolutionized how CUES operates, cutting meeting preparation time from weeks to days, streamlining governance, ensuring only the right stakeholders have access to sensitive information and increasing collaboration.
“I post our financials monthly in the portal. The right stakeholders have access, and there’s no worry about this information being shared.” - Ruth Shirley, Executive Administrator and Board Liaison, CUES

Their outdated, cumbersome governance system wasn’t cutting it, and the need for improvement was clear.

The challenge: Unsecure and inefficient systems

HSHS’s governance relied on an antiquated homegrown system. Posting documents required navigating three websites, simple tasks like adding new board members were a hassle and preparing physical binders for meetings was labor-intensive, often taking two days. What's more? The pandemic was shifting work to remote settings, highlighting the system’s cybersecurity limitations.

The solution: BoardEffect solidifies crisis resiliency

Enter BoardEffect. HSHS’s leadership, executive assistants and board members quickly saw the platform’s benefits when they faced a 15-day cyber incident that took down all their systems, BoardEffect stood strong. Despite the chaos, BoardEffect remained accessible and secure, allowing board members to retrieve crucial information and communicate confidentially. Key features like enhanced security provided peace of mind throughout a crisis, while user-friendly navigation won over even the most resistant users.

The results: Unmatched security and streamlined operations

BoardEffect has transformed HSHS’s governance. Say goodbye to manual binder prep and distribution. Everything is now centralized and secure. Board books and agendas are compiled and shared online quickly, and secure messaging has replaced time-consuming oversight.
"BoardEffect has been a game-changer for us. Having everything in one place has made our board's work so much easier and more efficient. During the cyber-incident, BoardEffect was secure and reliable. Knowing we could access it while everything else was down gave us a great sense of security." - Dani Glascock, System Director of Governance

Good governance for your mission-driven organization

When you hear governance, what comes to mind? Compliance? Bylaws? Board meetings? While these are crucial, true governance goes beyond the basics. It’s about creating a robust system that fuels your mission and drives exceptional performance. Good governance means having solid processes in place — rules that build a foundation, policies that guide your next steps, and coordinated activities that ensure informed oversight. Good governance depends on people. Leaders set the tone at the top for collaboration, thoughtful deliberation, and giving all stakeholders a voice. And today, good governance relies on technology. The right tools connect board members to crucial data , enabling smart decisions and foresight that drive exceptional performance. Our guide simplifies your governance with actionable insights and empowers your board with tools for secure communication and effective decision-making. Use the four essential elements in this guide as you get started on your good governance journey:
  1. Security: Protecting sensitive data and discussions from hackers, criminals and unauthorized eyes
  2. Efficiency: How to get more done faster, without compromising accuracy or effectiveness
  3. Ease of use: So board members are focused on the business at hand, not frustrated by disparate databases and difficult software
  4. Clarity: Bringing the right information to the surface at the right time, in a way that sharpens understanding and expedites smart decisions
What’s more, each section delivers practical tips on how the right technology can help.
